description:
[RSSAmp] Every feed filed under one topic. The keyword is normalised, so "Home Lab", "home lab" and "home-lab" all reach the same topic and you can pass a phrase you read anywhere. Each feed says whether it landed here from the publisher's own tag or from a phrase counted across its writing. A comma-separated list ("business, saas, crypto", up to 10) returns the union: every feed filed under any of them, each once, with `topics` naming the known ones and `unknown` the rest.

Served by RSSAmp (https://rssamp.com/mcp).

keyword.description: The topic, in any spelling — or several, separated by commas.

name: rssamplifier_get_topic
title: RSSAmp: Feeds covering a topic
